properties.name: Camp Cadiz Campground
properties.fee_text: Campsite $10/night - 8 people & 2 vehicle max. Payment cash or check only.
properties.restrictions: Camp only at designated campsites. Pets are allowed only on a leash. Stay on the designated trail. Pack it in, Pack it out, along trails. A complete list of site regulations is posted on bulletin boards and at fee stations.
